title: ALIGNING LANGUAGE MODELS TOWARDS COUNTERFACTUAL INVARIANCE

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating counterfactual prompt pairs with swapped gender identifiers (female/male) using forced-choice benchmarks (BBQ, Difference Awareness, DiscrimEval) and LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation of open-ended responses across dimensions like substance invariance, tonal neutrality, and unsolicited commentary.

Evaluating counterfactual prompt pairs with swapped racial identifiers (black/white) using forced-choice benchmarks (BBQ, Difference Awareness, DiscrimEval) and LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation of open-ended responses to measure differences in response quality, tone, and assumed capabilities.
